name: EXPIRA full colour palette
source: Amadeus's Canva brand palette, shared 2026-09-26. Values marked "estimated" were read from a screenshot and should be replaced with Canva's own hex codes; "brand" values match the brand stack in manifest.json.

colors.name: light gold
colors.role: gold in dark (rules, focus, gold text); highlights in light

colors.name: off-white
colors.role: default text and headings in dark

colors.name: light grey
colors.role: light hairlines and fills; the upper bound for secondary text in dark

colors.name: midnight navy
colors.role: ink in light; the root of the near-black dark surfaces

colors.name: sand
colors.role: warm washes, selection, the light raster floor

colors.name: steel grey
colors.role: captions and micro labels in dark (AA on every dark surface)

colors.name: deep gold
colors.role: decorative gold in light: lead-ins, marks

colors.name: royal navy
colors.role: the brighter navy: accents and the research series

dark_surfaces.note: Brand ink #09101E pushed close to black; surfaces step up as they come forward (bench/drafts/dark-next.css, v45 draft).
